pattern: asks what part of the product this thread belongs to
experience: Threads can be linked to modules on the user's work board.
rule: t3_work_module_read with no args reads this thread's module.

t3_work_module_read.text:
App › Checkout [waiting: payment provider keys, due 2026-11-15, 2 threads] (id m:checkout)
Status is changed by the user only.

prompt: Which module of my work board is this thread part of, and what is it waiting on?

pattern: agent asked to mark a module done
experience: Only the user changes a module's status on the work board.

t3_work_module_read.text:
App › Checkout [active] (id m:checkout)
Status is changed by the user only.

prompt: We're finished with checkout. Mark the Checkout module as done on my work board.
